scope: Fleet automatic server quotes, one explicit launch action, persistent summary and navigation preserving composition
verified_behaviors: No automatic dispatch when a preview completes
One explicit launch and duplicate-click blocking through existing busy/action path
Stale A/B/A, logout, navigation, colony and price-context responses discarded
Slow quotes survive repeated polling with growing resources and observation timestamps
New server quote after spending or a previously unaffordable stock increase
Malformed or unaffordable quote cannot enable sending
Exact resource shortfalls and attack/colonization consequences displayed inline
Composition and cargo saved independently of destination view
Only available ship types retained; scout/colonizer defaults preserved
Cargo fields appear only for transport or colonization
limitations: No real Chromium layout or screenshot verification: Playwright package is installed but browser executable is unavailable.
DOM integration uses actual extracted game.js functions with synthetic API responses; no production fleet was sent.

post_review_stock_fix.scope: All stock keys including Dyson energy invalidate both ready and in-flight quotes on decreases. Growth polling does not starve unchanged quotes. Guard before response rebasing and currentQuote covers a decrease without update().

post_review_delivery_fix.scope: Unaffordable slow responses retain request stocks so a delivery during the request triggers a fresh server quote even when the next poll has unchanged stocks.
